experiment_plan.objective: Evaluate the effect of replacing Ag/AgCl electrodes with dry electrodes on ECG signal quality
procedure: Prepare 20 participants with similar skin types and no prior experience with ECG devices
Divide participants into two groups: dry electrode group and conductive gel-based electrode group
Measure ECG signal quality for both groups using a standard ECG device
Have the dry electrode group use dry electrodes for 30 consecutive days without replacement
Measure ECG signal quality for the dry electrode group after 30 days of use
Compare the ECG signal quality of the dry electrode group with the conductive gel-based electrode group
